verdict.rationale: Airwallex exposes an extensive API/SDK surface covering accounts, cards, transfers, FX, expenses, bills, batch payments, webhooks, and scoped API keys, plus a CLI and AgentOS toolkit explicitly designed for AI agents to act on production accounts (reading balances, creating beneficiaries, issuing cards, cashflow reports), suggesting broad UI/API parity. However, the evidence doesn't explicitly confirm 1:1 parity for every UI action (e.g., account onboarding/KYC flows, dashboard-only settings) or provide independent confirmation that no UI feature lacks an API equivalent. Missing for 10: explicit statement or audit of full UI-API parity, independent verification of edge-case UI features not exposed via API.
